scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,api,web -c yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run db --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:neon: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.deploy:firebase: VITE_API_BASE=https://crewline-one.vercel.app/api npm run build --prefix client && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
